description: This file defines the WellKnownTypeCollection class, which manages a collection of well-known types with their associated IDs, providing methods to retrieve types by ID and vice versa. It is a core part of the serialization session in the Orleans framework, focused on handling frequently used types efficiently.

classes.name: WellKnownTypeCollection
classes.description: Manages well-known types and their identifiers for serialization purposes within Orleans.

methods.name: WellKnownTypeCollection
methods.description: Constructor initializing the collection with configuration-provided well-known type IDs.

methods.name: GetWellKnownType
methods.description: Retrieves a type based on its well-known type ID.

methods.name: TryGetWellKnownType
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a well-known type for a given ID, indicating success with a boolean.

methods.name: TryGetWellKnownTypeId
methods.description: Attempts to get the ID of a provided type, indicating success with a boolean.
